description: This file defines a PHP class 'WebResourceObserver' that extends 'ResourceObserver'. It provides a constructor and a notify method for web client notifications, including outputting messages and cleaning up resources.

classes.name: WebResourceObserver
classes.description: A subclass of ResourceObserver designed to handle notifications for web clients.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the WebResourceObserver with a module by calling the parent constructor.

methods.name: notify
methods.description: Outputs a message to the browser and performs cleanup using sugar_cleanup.
